echo_sets.name: Rejuvenating Glow
echo_sets.note: Healing Bonus plus 15% team ATK on heal; the Geochelone adds a shield that transfers to the next character.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: More Energy Regen and an Outro ATK buff for the next character; less healing than Rejuvenating Glow.

echo_sets.name: Rejuvenating Glow + Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Healing plus Energy Regen while farming a full 5-piece set.

build.energy_regen_target: not published; as high as possible — Energy Regen is her top substat priority
build.fast_path: Fast path: Stellar Symphony (or Variation) + 5-piece Rejuvenating Glow in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Bell-Borne Geochelone in the main slot. Run a Healing Bonus or HP% 4-cost, double Energy Regen 3-costs, HP% 1-costs — Energy Regen is her top substat so her Liberation cycles quickly and her Concerto stays ahead of the rotation.

ranked_weapons.name: Stellar Symphony
ranked_weapons.note: Shorekeeper's signature, not hers — but her best: HP% for bigger heals, Energy, and team ATK when she heals.

ranked_weapons.name: Variation
ranked_weapons.note: The classic healer pick: Energy Regen plus Concerto Energy on Resonance Skill.

ranked_weapons.name: Comet Flare
ranked_weapons.note: Healing Bonus that stacks on Basic and Heavy hits.

ranked_weapons.name: Call of the Abyss
ranked_weapons.note: Healing Bonus on Liberation; a solid free option.

ranked_weapons.name: Jinzhou Keeper
ranked_weapons.note: Intro-triggered ATK and HP; an accessible 4-star.

stat_priorities.note: Healing Bonus is standard; HP% works since her heals scale off HP.

profile.role_note: Free HP-scaling healer; her Outro grants All-Type DMG Deepen to the next character. Budget Verina.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Free from the Tidal Chorus convene — never pull for her; build her as the budget Verina for any team missing Shorekeeper or Verina.
